Ten years of shipping software taught me that code is the means, not the point. Now that AI agents write much of it, my job is the part they can't do: framing the problem, shaping the system and holding the quality bar. [I write about](/blog) how that works in practice. ## Experience ### Booking.com Mar – Oct 2026 *Senior Software Engineer* One of the world's largest online travel platforms. ### TLS Mar 2023 *Senior Front-end Developer* The visa and consular services partner trusted by governments around the world. ### Try Apr 2022 *Senior Front-end Developer* São Paulo design and research studio shaping products for brands like Avenue and Genial Investimentos.
See moreSee less ### Warren Nov 2021 *Front-end Developer* Major investment brokerage platform serving thousands of investors worldwide. ### Valtech May 2020 *Front-end Developer* Several major international brands and products: mail marketing, landing pages, and blogs. ### Kombi Jun 2019 *Front-end Developer & Designer UX* Focusing on SEO, UI, and front-end development of e-commerce platforms, landing pages, and blogs. ### ProBrain Jun 2018 *Front-end Developer & Designer UI / UX* Platform to carry the games and content for the clients to have the best experience. ### ProBrain Dec 2017 *Intern Game Developer* Development of games for pedagogical professionals and clients.
## Awards - **[Copper · App Sorocaba Award](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6597088980259393536/ "preview:/media/b515d243-3e6f-45d7-898b-9daa645bf45f.webp")** (2019) — The best website of the year for the agencies in Sorocaba and the region. - **[Gold · Tech Innovation Award](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rickmff/overlay/1602538714221/single-media-viewer/?profileId=ACoAACmaiHcBd54yI-rzRQ1PGXZMUSDfp4OEU8s "preview:/media/cbeb5e82-8da7-4b85-9eb5-9bdbba7db0cf.webp")** (2018) — The CEV 'Fonoaudiologia' Council awards the best software.
